homeLede: The released index of the Commission, set as plain pages. No workstation is required.
homeIntro: Every entry the Commission has released is listed here, with its designation, its class, and the date it was filed. Open an entry to read the record.
homeIntroNote: Records that are sealed, restricted, or held appear in the index and do not open to their filings.
homeBrowseNote: Eighteen entries are on file, in four classes.
homeLatestNote: The five most recent entries, newest first.
homeOrganizationsNote: Bodies that hold filings in this index.
homeWorkstationNote: The interactive edition opens records in a viewer, with annotations and the records filed against them. It is not required for reading.
indexLede: Every entry the Commission has released, in archive order.
indexNote: A designation is withheld where the releasing office withheld it. The code remains listed so that it is not reused.
recordWorkstationNote: The interactive edition opens this record in a viewer, with its annotations and follow-up strip.
explorationsLede: {count, plural, one {# exploration is filed against this record.} other {# explorations are filed against this record.}}
explorationsNote: Each exploration opens as a record of its own.
explorationsMetaDescription: The exploration records filed against {code} in the public archive.
recordHeldBody: The index entry is released. The filing itself is held at the desk.
orgLede: Bodies that hold filings in the released index.
orgNote: An organization is an entry in the directory; it is not a personnel account.
orgSearchPlaceholder: Code, designation, or words from the abstract
orgSearchResults: {count, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}} for “{query}”
orgCount: {count, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}} in the directory
recordTypeCount: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} filed under this class
recordTypeNote: Every entry filed under this class in the released index.
rumoursLede: Rumours carry no code. They are filed under an incident and read with it.
rumoursNote: No separate rumour index is served by this reading edition. Open an incident to read the rumours filed under it.
playlistsLede: Sequences of records arranged for reading, rather than for filing.
playlistsNote: No playlist index is served by this reading edition yet. A record carries the playlists it appears in.
charactersLede: People and presences entered in the archive's dossiers.
charactersNote: No character directory is served by this reading edition. A dossier opens by its code where the archive holds one.
aboutLede: What this page is, and how to read it.
aboutKeyHint: A class opens the index filtered by it. The code is a released example.
aboutRumourHint: Rumours carry no code. They are filed under an incident and read with it.
aboutStatusHint: A status opens the index filtered by it.
aboutBody: This is the public reading edition of the Commission's index. It carries the same entries as the workstation, without the workstation: every record has a page of its own, and every page can be read in any browser.
aboutUseBody: Entries are listed by code. A record opens on its own page with its particulars and the records filed against it. A designation that is withheld in the index stays withheld here, and a filing that is held at the desk does not open.
aboutClassIncidentBody: A reported event and its measurement.
aboutClassOrganizationBody: A body entered in the directory.
aboutClassExplorationBody: A deliberate expedition into an incident, written to learn its rules.
aboutClassEvidenceBody: A witness statement, interview, document, or other account filed against an incident.
aboutStatusSealedBody: Held at the desk; only the index entry is released.
aboutStatusErasedBody: Removed from discovery; the entry remains as a tombstone.
aboutClearanceBody: Classification describes the record, not the correspondent.
aboutWorkstationBody: The interactive edition runs on the Commission's workstation. Records open there in a viewer with annotations, a rating, and the records filed against them.
bannerText: The reading room is unstaffed until 09:00. Records remain open, and the index is current to 14.11.2003.
classifiedFoot: Unauthorized access will be recorded. Any subsequent manifestations are the responsibility of the individual.
searchHolderHint: Matches the printed holder code only.
dossierNotDocumented: No dossier text has been filed for this entry.
searchLegacyFilters: This link uses older filters. Organization classes now use result type; retired classes were removed.
searchInvalidFilters: Some invalid or oversized filters were omitted. Review the active filters before continuing.
searchEmptyArchive: No entries have been filed in this archive yet.

searchRateLimitBody: Wait a moment, then try again. Your search and filters are preserved.
searchNoMatchesHelp: Try a different term or clear the search and filters.

searchCodeReserved: The code {code} is reserved; no public filing is attached to it.

popularNote: Consultations recorded by the reading room this quarter.
randomNote: The archive will open a record it has not shown you.
downloadHeld: No copy is held for this filing.
notesLead: Annotations are part of the public record. Correspondents may file a note below.
noteComposerHint: Held in this browser only. The reading room files it under your name before it joins the public record.
noteNamePlaceholder: The name to file it under
noteHeld: Note not filed. It is held in this browser until the reading room files it.
writeIntro: Every account begins somewhere. Choose what you want to add to the record.
writeGuidelines: Read the guidelines and filing rules first
writeGuidelinesDetail: Author guidance, content warnings, and the rules of the archive.
writeIncidentDetail: Describe an encounter. Start with what happened, before anyone had an explanation.
writeEvidenceDetail: A photograph, a transcript, an object. Leave something that supports the account.
writeCharacterDetail: Give a witness, investigator, or recurring presence a place in the archive.
writeOrganizationDetail: Introduce a body with its own methods, motives, and interpretation of events.
writeRumourDetail: Put an unverified account on record. Not everything filed has been confirmed.
writeDraftNote: Saved in this browser. The incident editor currently keeps one active draft.
writeEmptyDetail: Your incident draft will appear here once you open the editor.
writeError: Drafts could not be read. Your saved copy has not been changed.
searchTagCycle: Click to include, again to exclude, again to clear.
destinationAcknowledgeBody: This incident is sealed. Acknowledge this notice to reveal the filed account.
destinationRequestBody: The body is available only to readers with an approved access request.
destinationRequestError: The request could not be submitted. Try again.
